reason: The top raw candidates provide context about the revolt (Sparta earthquake, Harelle) but lack direct connection to Ralph de Gael. A bridge note linking the revolt to the Norman Conquest could help organize evidence.

derived_candidates.text: The revolt led by Ralph de Gael occurred in the context of the Norman Conquest of England.
The Harelle was part of a larger crisis of the Late Middle Ages, not the Norman Conquest.
The 464 BC Sparta earthquake revolt increased tension between Sparta and Athens, unrelated to Ralph de Gael.
